title: Ambitious climate action will reap large dividends for Cabo Verde
temporal_coverage: Current vulnerabilities and GDP/tourism projections through 2050
methodology: World Bank official CCDR summary page describing sectoral exposure and headline projections.
limitations: Summary page omits assumptions behind 2050 estimates.

title: Cabo Verde Nationally Determined Contribution 3.0 (NDC)
temporal_coverage: Historical climate trends over approximately 50 years; current vulnerability assessment
methodology: Government NDC summarizing historical climate analysis and differentiated vulnerability assessments.
limitations: The cited vulnerability passages are national diagnostics; station-level and group-level methods are not detailed there.

title: Cabo Verde: Increasing Resilience to Disasters and Climate-Related Shocks
temporal_coverage: World Bank-supported disaster-risk reforms reported for 2018–2022
methodology: World Bank results brief describing a policy-financing operation and reported outputs.
limitations: Institutional achievements are publisher-reported results; the page does not provide an independent counterfactual evaluation.

title: Cabo Verde Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Current and historical exposure; climate scenarios through 2050 and 2100; cited social data years vary by indicator.
methodology: CCDR uses geospatial exposure analysis and climate scenarios.
limitations: Modeled estimates depend on stated thresholds and cited data years.

title: Cape Verde Floods: Operation Update #1 (MDRCV005)
organization: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
temporal_coverage: August 2025 floods and IFRC/Cabo Verde Red Cross response reported through 30 September 2025.
methodology: IFRC operation update reports crisis effects, local needs and response outputs for August–September 2025.
limitations: Operational figures and response outputs are not an independent post-disaster evaluation.

title: Cabo Verde launches national roll-out of Early Warnings for All
temporal_coverage: National Early Warnings for All rollout and draft roadmap announced in December 2025.
methodology: WMO update summarizing a national rollout and multi-stakeholder workshop.
limitations: The roadmap was still awaiting validation; no warning-system performance results are reported.

title: Building Adaptive Capacity and Resilience to Climate Change in the Water Sector in Cabo Verde
temporal_coverage: Completed UNDP/GEF water-sector adaptation project; page gives no project completion date.
methodology: UNDP project page describes intervention design, pilot locations and reported completion status.
limitations: Page does not name all municipalities or independently quantify adaptation outcomes.

title: Governo anuncia plano de emergência para mitigação da seca e mau ano agrícola
temporal_coverage: Government announcement of the 2017–2018 drought and poor agricultural-year emergency program.
methodology: Government announcement describing program scope, intended beneficiaries and implementation arrangements.
limitations: The announcement records approved measures, not delivery or effectiveness results.
